WITH c AS (SELECT id, name FROM companies WHERE slug IN ('castelo-da-diversao', 'megamegic', 'planeta-divertido'))
SELECT c.name AS empresa,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT w.lead_id) FROM wapi_conversations w JOIN campaign_leads l ON l.id = w.lead_id WHERE w.company_id = c.id AND w.last_message_from_me AND w.last_message_at BETWEEN now() - interval '7 days' AND now() - interval '3 days' AND l.status = 'orcamento_enviado') AS orcamento_3a7d,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT w.lead_id) FROM wapi_conversations w JOIN campaign_leads l ON l.id = w.lead_id WHERE w.company_id = c.id AND w.last_message_from_me AND w.last_message_at BETWEEN now() - interval '7 days' AND now() - interval '2 days' AND l.status = 'orcamento_enviado') AS orcamento_2a7d,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM wapi_conversations w WHERE w.company_id = c.id AND w.last_message_from_me AND w.last_message_at BETWEEN now() - interval '7 days' AND now() - interval '2 days' AND w.lead_id IS NOT NULL) AS convs_nossas_2a7d,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM lead_reactivation_history h WHERE h.company_id = c.id) AS reativacoes_total,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM lead_reactivation_history h WHERE h.company_id = c.id AND h.sent_at > now() - interval '30 days') AS reativacoes_30d,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM lead_visits v WHERE v.company_id = c.id AND v.visit_type = 'atendimento' AND v.data_visita::date > current_date - 90) AS atendimentos_90d,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM lead_visits v WHERE v.company_id = c.id AND v.visit_type = 'visita' AND v.data_visita::date > current_date - 90) AS visitas_90d
FROM c ORDER BY c.name
